stageReportSummary: Fixes #3037. Synchronized the live review and merge clauses in src/lib/orchestrator/prompt.ts:561 with the terminal policy: the last fix gets one terminal check, pass completes, fail parks, and automatic merging requires that check. Nonterminal advance behavior is preserved. Version 59, its fingerprint, exact shipped-text upgrades and contrary assertions are updated; pending intents retain their first bytes. The new mandate detector fails against the unchanged main prompt and passes here; all 69 prompt tests pass with both existing envelope guards. Sequential isolated gate-remote checks: TypeScript and touched-file ESLint exit 0; 34 whole test files checked (23 green, 11 with 105 matching baseline failures), zero introduced failures. The terminal-routing suite passes nine cases. Commands, file verdicts, hashes and the interrupted-run recovery are recorded in evidence/pipeline-terminal-mandate.json. Earlier successor-publication and terminal-runtime evidence remains in evidence/pipeline-terminal-review.json; its six source hashes still match. Plain commits use the normal hooks. No push, issue comments or workflow edits.
